svg.aria-label: Day 5: a student speaks at a DEC10 podium; her voice becomes a waveform broken into chunks with stressed beats. On an easel, an old flat-Earth map sits under a large magnifying glass, and a classmate raises her hand to ask Why?. On the right, a gold star floats above an Action plan clipboard with ticked rows and a pencil writing the next step.
